ns2:course.label: Persuasion Consumer Response
ns2:course.description: Addresses what makes a mass-mediated message persuasive by reviewing theories of mass communication and persuasion, consumer information-processing, and advertising effectiveness measures. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 281.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 281.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
